# PendingTransaction.pending

The **`pending`** method of the `PendingTransaction` interface returns `true` if the transaction lookup has not yet resolved.

This is a non-blocking check, and can be called any number of times before `wait()` is called.

## Syntax

```js
pending()
```

### Parameters

None.

### Return value

A boolean.
